styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating pastel pink scene panels and clean grey/white infographic panels, with one deep-black accent panel for the material story

styleLock.surfaceSystem: round terrazzo pedestal with gold ring trim, calm water surface, matte flat info panels

styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dreamy pastel travel luggage ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud white #FFFFFF, warm grey #EFEFEF, deep black #141414 and one dreamy pink accent #F2A9C4; neutral temperature, soft diffused studio lighting with front-left key and gentle contact shadow; modern geometric sans-serif short bold headlines in #141414 on light panels or #FFFFFF on dark panels; thin-line circle icons with short labels; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements on alternating pastel scene panels and grey info panels; stable product scale and centered placement with clean margins around the product; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 源为 11 片 800x1200 详情页切片（重叠 60px）。源文件夹名为箱包，实际内容为拉杆箱详情页，L1=箱包 L2=旅行 与源夹一致无需纠正。已剥离：会员角标与二维码、参数页假型号、质检宣称文案（一律省略不入模板）、全部原文案（改 callout 占位符）。panel-03 木框放大镜页仅取其放大视窗构图并入 shot-07；panel-09 四宫格细节内容模糊，按护角/拉杆/箱面/内里四路特写推断补全；panel-05 下半按静音轮卖点推断为轮组微距。收口 CTA 镜（shot-09）为转化漏斗补全，源图无对应页。与库内已有 6 款拉杆箱（基础款/铝镁合金硬壳/磨砂PC/复古铝框竖条纹/扩容分区商务/复古铆钉角扣登机）以「六色马卡龙配色+铝角竖条纹+静音轮」定位区分。
